annotations.title: Extract Brand Store Stockists & Buyer Emails

description: Extract retail stockists carrying external brands and enrich each store domain with verified buyer emails and DNS deliverability checks. Supply at least one source (urls, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId); omitting all sources returns 0 items at $0. Optional filters (onlyIndependentStores, onlyWithEmail, minReadinessScore) gate billing before charge, while maxStoresPerBrand (1-5,000) bounds fan-out per brand. Bills $5/1K stores ($0 when empty or filtered), runs ~15-60s per brand with per-store failure isolation in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and optionally posts to webhookUrl. Use for wholesale retail prospecting; do not use for editing your own store map or enriching corporate B2B companies (use enrich_b2b_company_leads instead).

countryFilter.description: Optional country code or name filter, e.g. "US", "GB", "CA", "AU", "DE", or "KR".

crmExportPreset.description: Optional flat CRM column mapping preset while preserving standard fields.

datasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID or URL containing brand or store locator URLs.

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) to output deliverabilityGrade (A-F) and emailProvider.

enrichEmails.description: Visit each unique retailer website (plus /wholesale and /contact) to extract buyer emails and social links.

maxStoresPerBrand.description: Maximum stockist locations to return per brand (1-5,000).

minReadinessScore.description: Minimum outreachReadinessScore (0-100) required to save and bill ($0 for filtered stores).

onlyIndependentStores.description: When true, skip national chains (Target, Walmart, Sephora, Whole Foods, etc.) at $0 and return independent boutiques and regional shops.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only stores where at least one valid email is found ($0 otherwise).

rawCsvOrUrls.description: Optional pasted CSV/TSV rows or newline-separated brand/locator URLs.

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId.

urls.description: Competitor brand homepages or store locator URLs, e.g. ["https://fellowproducts.com", "https://brooklynhotdogcompany.com"]. Optional when rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId is provided.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL notified with run metrics and top stockists on completion.

name: extract_brand_store_stockists

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Extracted retail stockist locations enriched with buyer contacts.

inboxType.description: Inbox risk classification (b2b_direct, general, cs_ticket_queue, or none).

retailerType.description: Classification such as independent_boutique or national_chain.

storeName.description: Physical retail store or boutique name.
